key_insight: DeepDOSReasoner predicts electronic and phonon densities of states from atomic structures while enforcing nonnegativity and total-state conservation by construction.
engineering_relevance: Millisecond spectral predictions enable high-throughput screening for electronic, optical, vibrational, and thermodynamic applications while reducing reliance on costly DFT calculations.
method: Decode spectra using atom-to-energy source attention.
Refine normalized spectra through learned continuity-equation transport.
Recover element-resolved contributions without direct supervision.
evidence_signal: The model led all evaluated prediction metrics for both spectrum types; new DFT calculations in a prospective screen of 8,106 materials confirmed valence-band gaps in 25 of its top 50 candidates.
watch_item: Physical constraints do not guarantee accuracy for unfamiliar chemistries, so high-value screening candidates still require DFT or experimental validation.
paper_title: DeepDOSReasoner: Physics-Grounded Reasoning for Density-of-States Prediction and Materials Discovery
